SYNTHETIC TEST SPECIFICATION, revision 1. Not a manufacturer datasheet or usable circuit.
Probe5, DEMO-5 package: 1 IN input; 2 GND power input; 3 OUT output;
4 EN input; 5 VCC power input. An example bypass is 100nF from VCC to GND.
The scope is a demonstration analog interface: core U1 and local bypass C1.
